reason: Expand the three q-Pochhammer symbols by definition. Their products show termwise that (q^{2d};q^{2d})_k=(q^d;q^d)_k(-q^d;q^d)_k. Substituting this into the kth summand of T_{d,r,n}(q) cancels one factor of (q^d;q^d)_k and gives exactly A_{d,r,n,k}(q). Summing over k proves the identity in Q(q).
